events.evidence: A United States federal judge approves media conglomerate Paramount Skydance's settlement with 12 states that challenged its acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery on antitrust grounds
American troops complete their withdrawal from Iraq, ending their 23-year presence in the country
Romania's parliament rejects prime minister-designate Siegfried Mureșan's proposed government

label.note: Paramount-Warner merger cleared; US exits Iraq; Romania political crisis persists, leaving overall risk appetite neutral.
